info.name: Tempy Hub API Copy 4
info.description:
Tempy Hub Backend — care-home SaaS API.
Import only this collection (variables live on the collection).
Base: {{url}} = http://localhost:6060/api/v1/
Accounts are created by an administrator; there is no public signup.
Run App → Auth → Login to save token into collection variables.
Note: communications/* email helpers and send-notification are not mounted in commonRoutes by default.
Auth: POST auth/login and GET auth/me return the same `access` block (memberships, modules, moduleMenu, moduleAccess, organizations). `/auth/me` also returns `user`, `staffProfile`, and `hasDirectReports`.

request.description:
### Send Email

This endpoint allows you to send an email to the specified recipients.

#### Request Body

- title (string, optional): The title of the email.
    
- emails (array of strings): The list of email addresses to which the email will be sent.
    
- subject (string, required): The subject of the email.
    
- body (string, required): The body content of the email.
    
- config (object):
    
    - fromEmail (string, required): The sender's email address.
        
    - isHtml (boolean, required): Indicates whether the email body is in HTML format.
        

#### Response

The response is in JSON format with the following schema:

``` json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "message": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}

 ```
